def clean_and_round(value):
    # Do not affect formulas
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
        return value

    if value is None:
        return None

    # Clean text: remove non-breaking spaces and trim leading/trailing normal spaces
    if isinstance(value, str):
        cleaned = value.replace("\u00A0", "").replace(chr(160), "").strip()
        # Also remove any other non-printing control characters
        cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in cleaned if ord(ch) >= 32)
        if cleaned == "":
            return ""
        # If the cleaned text is numeric, round to remove decimals
        try:
            d = Decimal(cleaned.replace(",", ""))
            return int(d.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
        except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
            return cleaned

    # If the value is already numeric, round to remove decimals
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        d = Decimal(str(value))
        return int(d.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

    return value

for row in range(1, 4):

    cell.value = clean_and_round(cell.value)
